items.title: Herbie Hancock interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 18, 1995
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Monk' in a meta-commentary to the production team ('Monk, can I put a plug in here...'), not as part of the conversation with Herbie Hancock. Herbie Hancock does not respond to or acknowledge this mention.

ctx.x: The foundation is called The Rhythm of Life Foundation. And I look at programs like CNN and other news programs and I see what’s happening to humanity. Humanity is in pretty bad shape you know. And so I’m thinking, something’s wrong with this picture. If the measure of the value of something, isn’t it supposed to be what it does for humanity? It should be that anyway. Then what is technology doing for humanity if humanity is in the toilet and technology is going through the roof? So there is something wrong with…

And I can also see how your music would be at the spearhead of that. Listen we’ve got to let you go because you’ve got to play tonight. This has been wonderful. Monk, can I put a plug in here and say can we do round two sometime? Because he’s not even started, he’s not even warmed up yet. But we’re filming for Hamilton College Jazz Archives. We have been with one of the icons of this country in music, Herbie Hancock. Thank you.
Yeah, thank you very much. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
